_comment: Port allocation scheme per ADR 0014. Internal ports are Docker overlay only (no host mapping). Where a host mapping is needed for an internal service it MUST be loopback-only (127.0.0.1:<port>:<port>) — never a bare <port>:<port> mapping, which publishes to all host interfaces. Only the explicitly listed host ports are published to all interfaces: gateway range (20100-39900), is-fleet (29999), and is-tempo (29996). The gateway_host_ports range (20100-39900) is consumed by 1Install.ps1 for the Windows Firewall rule. Retired ports are never reassigned — see ADR 0014 §4. Gateway keys are lowercase role codes (base, orch, veri, work) matching Get-AgentHostPort's .ToLower() lookup — each role gets a non-overlapping /24 block (base=20300, orch=20400, veri=20500, work=20600) with max 9 instances per role.

_notes.mcp_browserless (3003): Intentionally in the upstream_internal range (3000-3999) rather than mcp_sidecar_internal (21000-21999) because Browserless uses its native port 3003. Port 21006 is skipped in the registry to avoid confusion with the old stale documentation value.
_notes.is-tempo host (29996): Published to host for operational access via port 29996. Internal port 21015. Port assignments documented in ADR-0042 § Port assignments.
_notes.is-hermes (21012): Hermes — official Nous Research Hermes Agent (v2). Internal port 21012 retained for compatibility, but no host publishing; gateway-out (Telegram/Discord/CLI) + CLI-in.
_notes.is-marketer (21011), is-monitoring (2101: Loopback-host-reachable (127.0.0.1) for operational access (tooling/health) only — the compose generator binds these to 127.0.0.1, never to all host interfaces. DocuSign public ingress (port 21007) is retired; signing is handled by the self-hosted Upscale Havens backend.
_notes.aqe (21004), web (21005): Ports are deprecated 2026-08-20 in favor of the cross-harness /aqe and /web-research skills. The container endpoints remain available for legacy callers (e.g. aqe-bridge) until those callers are redirected to local scripts or the plugin.
_notes.agent-credential-broker (21016): Internal overlay only, never host-published. Broker listens on the agent-broker-net overlay; workers reach it by service name. Registered 2026-08-14 with ADR 0047 swarm wave (plan swarmcredentials-1).
